title: The YITH WooCommerce Gift Cards WordPress plugin before 4.38.1 does not lock or atomically update a gift card's…
description: A vulnerability in the YITH WooCommerce Gift Cards WordPress plugin versions before 4.38.1 allows attackers to redeem a gift card multiple times concurrently, spending more than the card's funded value. This occurs because the plugin does not lock or atomically update the gift card balance during checkout.
